meta.parties: Vasudeva Nanayakkara v. Choksy And Others (John Keells Case)

rules.statement: The executive action taken by P. B. Jayasundara, as Chairman of the Public Enterprise Reform Commission (PERC) and Cabinet member, in selling shares of Lanka Marine Services Ltd (LMSL) without prior approval from the Cabinet, and making an unauthorized representation regarding the transfer of state land, violated proper procedures and potentially infringed on the fundamental right to equal protection under Article 126.
rules.supporting_quote: It is significant that although the Ratnayake has stated that all bidders were thus notified, Z18 is addressed only to him by name. It is not in the format in which the minutes of the Pre bid Conference were communicated which contained all the names of those who attended the conference.
